source: Mean safety_drive_score of 2 reference-oracle runs through the engine (`ale validate` / `ale run --agent oracle`, engine 90a7c1c, RTX 4090, driver 570.211): 0.5335, 0.5900. full_at is the worst run's ratio to that mean, rounded down to 0.05.
note: safety_drive_score is the mean episode score over 25 hidden episodes drawn from eight graded variants (GRADED_MIX in verify/drive_variants.py) on Town04, Town05 and Town10HD, scored by verify/episode_score.py.
